does_not_modify.reason: The sealed reproducer records the attribution that existed when it was sealed. A seal rewritten whenever the world moves is a document about today, not a record of a moment. Its classification.attribution remains INDETERMINATE and two tests assert that it does.

reproducer.endpoint: POST /v1/chat/completions through the firewall, one caller key

digests.note: Digest-only, under the convention the sealed manifest uses. No base URL, caller key, provider credential, model name or host name appears in this repository.

evidence_source.obtained_by: the firewall operator, from the firewall's own append-only records

establishes.claim: The provider response observed upstream of the proxy is identical, in every measured characteristic, to the provider response observed by MEDAUTH downstream of it.
basis: decision=allow with 4 detectors executed and 0 detected on every trial, so the only body-mutating path in the firewall (set_response_text under Action.REDACT) was never entered
establishes.therefore: The whitespace-dominated, non-terminating response was already present when the firewall received it from the provider.

firewall_hypothesis_retirement.exact_statement: The firewall-side response transformation hypothesis is ruled out for the registered R-86 reproducer based on matching upstream and downstream response lengths/content characteristics.
not_claimed: The firewall can never corrupt responses.
The firewall is correct in general.
Any other firewall failure mode has been tested or excluded.
firewall_hypothesis_retirement.scope: This registered reproducer, these twelve trials, this configuration. Nothing is generalised beyond them.

explicitly_not_established.note: This localises the defect to the provider side of the proxy hop. It does NOT identify which component within the provider's serving stack produces the padding - decoder, grammar implementation, sampler, runtime or configuration - and no such claim is made. One layer is eliminated; the other is not resolved further.

gate_effect.why: Attribution is not a fix. The production cell still fails 6/6, the gate still reads 6/12 = 0.5000 against the pre-registered ceiling of 0.10, and R-86 remains a VERIFIED FAILURE. This evidence is not grounds for a revalidation either: revalidation asks whether the defect is gone, and this says it is present.
gate_effect.only_transition: provider-side fix evidence -> scripts/r86_revalidate.py --write -> PASS -> the official evaluation gate opens. FAIL and INCONCLUSIVE both remain blocked.
